text: Welcome to G3TA. Choose the standard trip brief or the voice-guided accessible experience.

transition_list.condition_text: User chooses the standard trip brief

text: Collect or review the origin, destination, dates, budget, traveler count, preferences, timing needs, and must-see places. Do not begin planning until the user submits the trip brief.
Validate and normalize the submitted trip brief.
Create the stable trip identifier and save the trip metadata.

transition_list.condition_text: Planning session could not be created

text: Run the Budget Agent first so every specialist receives the same category caps.
Run Transportation, Housing, Food, Activity, and Planning Agents concurrently with the Budget Agent guidance.
Confirm that every location-bearing agent result belongs to the requested destination.
Reconcile real costs, apply safe budget trade-offs, and synthesize one destination-correct day-by-day itinerary.

transition_list.condition_text: Final itinerary could not be synthesized

text: The planned trip is ready. Present the itinerary, destination map, reconciled budget, packing list, weather, and agent reasoning log. This is the end of the planning state chart.

Start the optional voice-guided accessible trip intake. Explain that the assistant will ask the same trip-brief questions one at a time, advance after each final voice answer, and start planning after the final validated answer.

Speak the current trip-brief question and accept a voice or typed answer. A final voice answer advances automatically. Ask about origin, destination, dates, budget and currency, cuisines, activity style, transportation, constraints, must-see places, and traveler count.
Store the current answer without inventing missing information.
Parse and normalize the complete guided description into a validated trip input for the normal planning pipeline.

transition_list.condition_text: Guided description could not be parsed

text: The trip brief needs correction. Keep all entered values visible and identify the invalid or missing fields.
The planning session could not be created. Preserve the trip brief and offer a retry.

transition_list.condition_text: User returns to the trip brief

text: The Budget Agent could not establish shared spending guidance. Preserve the trip brief and offer a retry.

transition_list.condition_text: User returns to the trip brief

text: A specialist agent failed. Do not synthesize an incomplete trip; preserve completed work and offer a retry.

transition_list.condition_text: User returns to the trip brief

text: An agent returned inconsistent destination data. Do not show mixed-city results; preserve the trip brief and offer a clean specialist retry.

transition_list.condition_text: User returns to the trip brief

text: The specialist results could not be combined into a valid itinerary. Preserve the agent outputs and offer synthesis again.

transition_list.condition_text: User returns to the trip brief

text: Voice recognition is unavailable. Keep the user inside guided setup and offer typed answers to the same questions.
Required information is missing. Stay in guided setup, explain what is missing, and repeat only the relevant question.
The guided answers could not be parsed. Keep every answer available and offer another guided parsing attempt without sending the user to the regular form.
